entities.summary: Bard College Berlin is a private, non-profit institution of higher education in Berlin, Germany. It was founded as a non-profit association in 1999. Courses are taught in the English language, and the college has a high percentage of international students and international faculty. It is one of the few liberal arts colleges in Europe. Qualifying students earn both an American B.A. and a German B.A.
